title: Don't ship what you can't measure: Evaluation-driven development for AI analytics agents
description:
Don't ship what you can't measure: how Data Culture used evaluation-driven development to take an AI analytics agent from zero trust to 94.7% accuracy on dbt and Snowflake. From dbt Summit 2026.

Explore dbt Summit 2026 and watch more sessions: https://www.getdbt.com/dbt-summit

Opeyemi Fabiyi, director of analytics engineering at the consultancy Data Culture, explains how the team applied evaluation-driven development, a concept drawn from Chip Huyen's AI Engineering book. Naive exact-match comparison marked correct answers wrong over cosmetic mismatches like column names, so the team improved how answers are scored. On one deployment, accuracy climbed from 0% with no semantic context to 94.7% after layering in modeled dbt tables, column descriptions, and business context.

In this session you'll learn:
• How to measure the accuracy of an AI analytics agent
• Why exact-match evals mislead
• Which layers of dbt context moved accuracy the most

Speaker: Opeyemi Fabiyi, director of analytics engineering, Data Culture

Learn more about the dbt Semantic Layer: https://www.getdbt.com/product/semantic-layer
